node.title: Admissible F2 weighted odd-prefix L2 identity
node.statement: For one admissible prime-field class, if N(v) counts subsets of the half-system with a prescribed first-R odd-moment vector, then Z_1=2^{-S} sum_v N(v)^2 exactly. Equivalently Z_1 is the normalized cosine-product Fourier partition function. Hence Z_1>=max(1,2^S/p^R), and the desired subexponential mass is exactly a near-diagonal L2 collision bound. This is not a full max-fiber Q theorem.
